handoffs.message: Review blocked: direct smoke passes with python3 tests/run_capital_binding_smoke.py, but python3 -m pytest tests/run_capital_binding_smoke.py -q fails with SystemExit: 0 because test_capital_binding_disabled() calls sys.exit() inside a pytest-collected test. Convert the check to assertions/unittest or move CLI exit handling under __main__ so the smoke remains directly runnable and pytest-targetable; prefer a canonical non-active binding status such as suspended or revoked for the disabled-binding case.
